title: Courtyard Waltz Complete  (完整的庭院圆舞曲)

segments.t: 城市里六点钟到了。在九号房间温暖的光芒中，伊芙琳站在胡桃木立式钢琴旁，而阿瑟、汉娜和二十多位邻居正透过敞开的绿色百叶窗聆听。先听一遍吧。
Good evening, friends, and welcome back to Friday tea in Room Nine.
Thirty years ago in May, my aunt started a little waltz right at this piano.
Rain interrupted page two, until Hannah and Graham opened these shutters again.
And tonight, our neighbor from number ten joins Miss Evelyn on the violin!
Ready on three, my friend? One, two, three...
Listen to the violin soar when the piano reaches middle D, Arthur!
Even my glasses are misty, and for once I know right where they are!
Look outside: people walking down Linden Street have stopped by the gate to listen!
And there is our gentle final chord, one octave high, home again.
Bravo! Bravo, Evelyn! Hear the whole courtyard clapping!
Take a bow yourself, Arthur. Your aunt's Friday room is alive again.
And nobody wants to go home yet. Time for the cinnamon rolls!
现在，我们放慢节奏，仔细回味这段动人的英语对话。
Good evening, friends, and welcome back to Friday tea in Room Nine.
「晚上好，朋友们，欢迎回到九号房间的星期五下午茶。」 当一个地方在漫长的停歇后重新敞开大门，这句欢迎词
welcome back to
带着深切的情感，迎接所有人回到这个充满珍贵回忆的传统中。
Thirty years ago in May, my aunt started a little waltz right at this piano.
「三十年前的五月，我姑姑就是在这架钢琴上开始创作一首小圆舞曲的。」 在英文中，月份前面总是使用介词
in May
而且要注意，十二个月份的首字母都必须大写哦。
Rain interrupted page two, until Hannah and Graham opened these shutters again.
「一场雨打断了第二页的乐谱，直到汉娜和格雷厄姆再次打开了这些百叶窗。」 只需要一个词就能表达我们说的“直到……为止”：连词
until
直接连接了一般过去时。
And tonight, our neighbor from number ten joins Miss Evelyn on the violin!
「而今晚，我们十号房间的邻居将用小提琴为伊芙琳小姐伴奏！」 要指出某人加入演奏时使用的是什么乐器，英语习惯说
on the violin
字面上看是“在小提琴上”。
Ready on three, my friend? One, two, three...
「数到三准备好，朋友？一，二，三……」 在开始一段二重奏或者一起抬重物之前，这句提示
Ready on three
通过数到三来给出精准的入场信号。
Listen to the violin soar when the piano reaches middle D, Arthur!
「阿瑟，你听，当钢琴弹到中音 D 时，小提琴的声音多么高亢飞扬！」 在感官动词之后，不带 to 的不定式在
Listen to the violin soar
中描绘了旋律腾飞的画面，而英美音乐体系把中央 D 键称为
middle D
也就是格雷厄姆修好的那个琴键。
Even my glasses are misty, and for once I know right where they are!
「连我的眼镜都起雾了，而且破天荒地，我居然清楚知道它们在哪儿！」 因激动而蒙上一层水汽的镜片可以形容为
misty
接着，阿瑟用这句俏皮的话嘲笑了自己平时的健忘：
for once
破天荒地，就这一次！
Look outside: people walking down Linden Street have stopped by the gate to listen!
「快看外面：沿着菩提树街散步的人们都在大门旁停下来听了！」 不需要关系代词，分词在
people walking down
中直接修饰了沿着人行道走下来的路人。
And there is our gentle final chord, one octave high, home again.
「这就是我们温柔的最终和弦，高一个八度，又回家了。」 这里要注意发音哦：
chord
表示和弦，这里的 h 是不发音的，接下来跟着
one octave high
表示高出了一个八度。
Bravo! Bravo, Evelyn! Hear the whole courtyard clapping!
「太棒了！太棒了，伊芙琳！听听整个庭院的掌声！」 所有的听众都在鼓掌：热情地拍手在英语里简单地用
clapping
它是动词 clap（拍手）的进行时形式。
Take a bow yourself, Arthur. Your aunt's Friday room is alive again.
「你自己也鞠个躬吧，阿瑟。你姑姑的星期五茶室又恢复生机了。」 放在动词后面，强调代词在
Take a bow yourself
中，邀请主人一同分享这份掌声，随后用表语
alive again
再次焕发生机。
And nobody wants to go home yet. Time for the cinnamon rolls!
「而且现在谁都不想回家。该吃肉桂卷啦！」 否定主语要求动词使用单数形式，所以在
nobody wants
里动词加了 s，而这个不需要动词的轻快短语
Time for
则宣告了甜点时间的到来。让我们再次从头到尾聆听这首完整的圆舞曲。
Good evening, friends, and welcome back to Friday tea in Room Nine.
Thirty years ago in May, my aunt started a little waltz right at this piano.
Rain interrupted page two, until Hannah and Graham opened these shutters again.
And tonight, our neighbor from number ten joins Miss Evelyn on the violin!
Ready on three, my friend? One, two, three...
Listen to the violin soar when the piano reaches middle D, Arthur!
Even my glasses are misty, and for once I know right where they are!
Look outside: people walking down Linden Street have stopped by the gate to listen!
And there is our gentle final chord, one octave high, home again.
Bravo! Bravo, Evelyn! Hear the whole courtyard clapping!
Take a bow yourself, Arthur. Your aunt's Friday room is alive again.
And nobody wants to go home yet. Time for the cinnamon rolls!
钢琴和小提琴将这首完整的《庭院圆舞曲》送入了温暖的星期五夜晚，迎来了热烈真诚的掌声。我们下个场景见。
Have a nice evening!
